name: SEIL Lab
fullName: Social Interaction and Embodied Intelligence Lab
title: Assistant Professor
department: School of Psychology & Surrey Institute for People-Centred AI (PAI)
description: SEIL Lab investigates how people attend to social information, integrate cues across senses, and interact and cooperate with humans and artificial agents. We connect cognitive experiments, neuroscience and computational modelling with human-robot and human-AI research. Across five complementary themes, artificial agents serve both as interaction partners and as experimental tools: helping us test accounts of human social behaviour and develop human-grounded embodied AI.
address: School of Psychology & Surrey Institute for People-Centred AI (PAI), University of Surrey, Guildford, UK
